rule: Never fake weather-station operation by rotating/bobbing/scaling the whole sprite. Body is static; sensor/vane use measured physical pivots after the part pass.

semantic_triggers.weather_preview_requested: sensor performs one deliberate scan/pass and indicator acknowledges forecast generation
semantic_triggers.weather_window_selected: short physical/state confirmation only; do not run a perpetual celebration loop

environment_response.cup_anemometer: rotation rate follows shared wind strength when the selected era physically contains cups

pivot_policy: sensor/vane pivots remain null until approved processed parts are measured
